data_quality.source_unit_note: A unidade da alimentação foi confirmada pelo usuário como g/min. A anotação g/mm na planilha é inconsistente e não é usada pelo pipeline; derivados nominais usam g/min.
data_quality.design_note: Rótulos ausentes não são imputados como medições. Réplicas da mesma condição ficam agrupadas na validação por combinação.

target_definitions.H_um: mean deposited height above original substrate surface
target_definitions.h_um: source column h mean; treated as penetration depth under the source-study definition
target_definitions.DI_pct: source-table dilution percentage; source article defines 100*h/(h+H)
target_definitions.HW: derived table ratio H/W; not an independent physical measurement

schema.feed_unit_confirmation: g/min confirmado pelo usuário; o rótulo g/mm na planilha é inconsistente e foi sobrescrito.
schema.support_note: Marginal bounds do not guarantee support throughout their Cartesian product; distances are descriptive only.

interpretation_guardrails: Only H, W and h are fitted as regressors; H/W and DI are derived deterministically from their predictions.
This package predicts measured geometric targets; it does not classify defects.
Nested grouped cross-validation uses up to 4 outer and 3 inner folds; it primarily estimates interpolation within this small design.
Factor-level holdouts are internal stress tests; they do not validate transfer to another machine, campaign, material, substrate, or optical setup.
Empirical absolute-error bands are not conformal intervals or probabilities of geometric conformity.
No defect probability is trained because no per-specimen defect labels and inspection protocol were supplied.
Energy and powder-per-length values are nominal indicators, not absorbed energy, captured mass, deposition productivity, or electrical efficiency.
Powder feed unit g/min was confirmed by the user; the inconsistent spreadsheet label g/mm is overridden.
The four multipass block outcomes from the source article are stored as external context, not as single-track training labels.

reference_window.scope: Study-specific geometric screening only; not universal defect thresholds.

source_study_multipass_block_evidence.use: Context-only evidence for candidate assessment; not included in model fitting or interpreted as transferable defect probabilities.
source_study_multipass_block_evidence.measured_percentage_definition: Table 4 porosity (%) includes both porosity and lack of fusion.

cases.reason: O artigo relata que os cordões a 300 W não atingiram a diluição-alvo e foram descartados da seleção.
O artigo relata marcas de oxidação a 600 W independentemente da alimentação de pó e velocidade; essas condições foram excluídas da análise subsequente.

source_study_power_gates.use: Selection observations from the source article; not defect classifier labels or universal material/process thresholds.
